content: {"episode_id":"ep-05021","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), along with a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9). The monitoring is required to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of the patient's current rate-control therapy. These documented clinical indications establish the medical necessity of the service, and we request reconsideration of the PR-204 determination in light of the submitted records."}
